confirmedAudience: Multiple companies using TaskFlow as SaaS
reviewType: Static implementation/product/architecture review and official documentation research; no new runtime security or load verification

findings.finding: No Workspace/Organization entity or tenant key on Projects, Tasks, ActivityLogs or memberships: [entities](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Domain/Entities/Entities.cs), [schema](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/EntityConfigurations.cs).
findings.impact: Cannot express a company boundary or safely scope future company administration.
findings.recommendation: Workspace model, membership and enforced tenant scope across DB/API/UI/jobs/files/exports.

findings.finding: Only project Owner/Member roles; owner identity is immutable inside [transactions](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Infrastructure/Projects/ProjectTransactions.cs).
findings.impact: No company admin, guest/read-only policy, owner handover or deprovisioning lifecycle.
findings.recommendation: Separate workspace roles from project permissions; explicit transfer, suspension, last-owner and leave policies.

findings.finding: Project row locks serialize mutations, but Project/Task have no client expected-version contract: [transactions](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Infrastructure/Projects/ProjectTransactions.cs), [task requests](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Api/Controllers/TasksController.cs). Identity concurrency stamps do exist.
findings.impact: Two editors can overwrite a changed title/description without a stale-edit warning.
findings.recommendation: App-managed entity revisions and conflict-aware forms/inline updates; keep membership locks.

findings.finding: [Account service](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Infrastructure/Identity/AccountService.cs) implements register/login/profile/logout only; no verification/recovery flows or configured email-token delivery.
findings.impact: Cannot safely self-serve recovery or prove control of invitation email addresses.
findings.recommendation: Verified email, reset/change password and reauthentication, using framework token providers and durable delivery.

findings.finding: Containers, hosted CI and chosen-host smoke remain unexecuted in the [runbook](../docs/release-runbook.md).
findings.impact: Local verification cannot establish public-service readiness.
findings.recommendation: Real CI/container/host rehearsal, HTTPS/proxy/secrets checks and production rollback/recovery evidence.

findings.finding: ActivityLog has actor/project/task/action/details/time, but no general entity reference, schema version, correlation or comprehensive before/after contract. Detail JSON already records assignment and status information: [writer](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Infrastructure/Projects/ProjectTransactions.cs), [reader](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Infrastructure/Projects/ActivityService.cs).
findings.impact: Cannot reliably explain all changed fields or correlate future company-wide actions.
findings.recommendation: Versioned structured audit events and field allowlists; retain legacy summaries as legacy events.

findings.finding: [Activity query filter](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/EntityConfigurations.cs) hides all events whose parent project is deleted. Individual deleted-task events remain visible in active projects.
findings.impact: Company administrators cannot review project-deletion history through current routes.
findings.recommendation: Separate privileged tenant audit query that can include deleted resources without reopening their ordinary content routes.

findings.finding: [File sink](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Api/Logging/SiemFileLoggerProvider.cs) is allowlisted operational NDJSON; no company/actor/security-outcome audit service or proven external retention.
findings.impact: Successful request status alone is not an attributable company security audit. Rotated local files are not tamper-evident evidence.
findings.recommendation: Separate security events, company-scoped audit authorization, external collection/alerts and documented retention.

findings.finding: No durable outbox/worker, event consumers, reminder scheduler or email sender in tracked services.
findings.impact: Directly adding email to request handlers would introduce lost/duplicate-message and latency risks.
findings.recommendation: MySQL-backed transactional outbox, worker leases, retries, deduplication and delivery visibility.

findings.finding: [Membership](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Api/Controllers/ProjectMembersController.cs) accepts an existing user ID; no Invitation entity/routes.
findings.impact: Company onboarding is manual and cannot safely invite a new or unverified account.
findings.recommendation: Email invitation lifecycle: accept, reject/cancel, expiry, resend and role/project scope.

findings.finding: No inbox, notification preferences, subscriptions or delivery records.
findings.impact: Users must repeatedly inspect task/project screens to discover changes.
findings.recommendation: In-app inbox first, then email preferences, assignment/mention updates, reminders and digests.

findings.finding: Three fixed task states, no persisted board rank/columns; table inline status exists.
findings.impact: No visual workflow or stable manual prioritization.
findings.recommendation: Accessible three-column Kanban with per-column paging/counts and conflict-safe moves; custom workflows later.

findings.finding: Task lists are project-scoped; dashboard shows counts and one recent-project preview.
findings.impact: No cross-project My work, due/overdue queue, persisted views or global authorized search.
findings.recommendation: Tenant-scoped personal queues and saved views using the same access predicates as existing task queries.

findings.finding: No comments, mentions or watcher entities.
findings.impact: Decisions/discussion happen outside the task and cannot drive focused alerts.
findings.recommendation: Task conversations with edit/deletion policy, sanitized text, scoped mentions and subscriptions.

findings.finding: Soft deletion exists but no archive, trash, restore or ownership-transfer API.
findings.impact: Users cannot recover accidental deletion or manage inactive work and staff departure.
findings.recommendation: Archive vs delete semantics, bounded restore window and explicit ownership transfer.

findings.finding: [Activity hub](../TaskFlow-FE/src/components/Workspace.tsx) lists the first 100 projects; [export](../TaskFlow-FE/src/features/activity/ActivityPage.tsx) covers only the current page.
findings.impact: Neither is a searchable company audit console or complete asynchronous export.
findings.recommendation: Server-side tenant audit filters/cursor paging and permission-checked export jobs; keep current-page export clearly labeled.

findings.finding: Frontend feature files combine queries/forms/actions and [CSS](../TaskFlow-FE/src/workspace.css) layers many overrides; OpenAPI documents some dynamic payloads incompletely.
findings.impact: Feature growth will increase change risk and contract drift.
findings.recommendation: Incremental shared form/dialog/table primitives, feature hooks, split components and accurate typed contracts.

findings.finding: Project mutations lock a parent project; queries use offset paging and substring search; [indexes](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/EntityConfigurations.cs) are limited to the current model.
findings.impact: Hot projects and larger tenant datasets may contend or scan; no demonstrated capacity failure is claimed.
findings.recommendation: Representative tenant/load measurements, tenant-first indexes, bounded export/jobs, keyset feeds and query-plan review before optimization.

findings.finding: Local request logs/readiness exist, but no application metrics/tracing exporter, error-budget dashboard, tenant-aware quota or fleet limiter.
findings.impact: Cannot manage noisy neighbors, delivery backlog or service objectives across companies.
findings.recommendation: Measured SLOs, central traces/metrics, per-tenant quotas and shared limiter when multiple replicas are introduced.

findings.finding: No tags, subtasks, dependencies, recurring tasks, milestones or calendar.
findings.impact: Limited planning depth beyond single independent tasks.
findings.recommendation: Incremental planning model after collaboration/board adoption; cycle-safe dependencies and timezone-safe recurrence.

findings.finding: No attachments/object-store pipeline or file scanning/download authorization.
findings.impact: Cannot collaborate on artifacts; adding naive uploads would expand security/storage costs.
findings.recommendation: Private object storage, validation/quarantine/scanning, quotas, expiring authorized downloads and deletion lifecycle.

findings.finding: No subscription/entitlement model, seat accounting, billing webhooks or customer administration.
findings.impact: Cannot operate a paid multi-company product consistently.
findings.recommendation: Pilot limits immediately; versioned plan entitlements, seats and provider-verified idempotent billing before charging customers.

findings.finding: No webhooks, public API credentials, calendar integration or tenant-scoped connector settings.
findings.impact: Work cannot connect reliably to customers' tools.
findings.recommendation: Scoped/revocable credentials, signed webhook delivery with retries, and outbound destination controls.

findings.finding: No MFA setup UI, enterprise federation or SCIM. Current password/session controls are useful but narrower: [auth configuration](../TaskFlow-BE/TaskFlow.Api/Extensions/AuthenticationExtensions.cs).
findings.impact: Cannot satisfy stronger customer identity requirements.
findings.recommendation: MFA/recovery codes early in SaaS onboarding; OIDC/SAML broker and SCIM when demanded by enterprise customers.

findings.finding: [CI](../.github/workflows/ci.yml) has build/test/deployment smoke, but no scheduled dependency/secret/static-security scan or SBOM job. [Release receipts](../scripts/release_manifest.py) provide checksums, not publisher signatures.
findings.impact: Dependency drift and provenance risks are not continuously checked by the current pipeline.
findings.recommendation: Add scoped vulnerability/secret/static checks, dependency update policy, SBOM and deployment artifact provenance/signing according to the chosen host.
